Reading Bookmark Fixture

This page is intentionally long so Page Scroll Master can save and restore a meaningful scroll percentage.

Section 1. The content here is plain text and avoids application code so the extension behavior is the only moving part.

Section 2. The page uses the document scrolling element, matching common article pages.

Section 3. The bottom padding creates enough scroll range for percentage-based restore checks.

Section 4. Manual bookmark saving should store the normalized URL and current percentage.

Section 5. Restore prompts should only scroll after the Continue action is clicked.
